name: 3 Riberas

known.via: English Wikipedia "3 Riberas" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Navarre vino de la tierra (IGP), a Spanish geographical indication one step below the Denominación de Origen level and mirroring the vins de pays of French wine. It gained that status.
